LAUNCH DUTY STATION
ARCHIVED FINAL SHIFT / 6083
OPERATOR: ARON<New>Release order received. Bank
Four opened. Local
abort refused. Request for
recall sent to Central
Control.<New>STAFF MESSAGE
FROM: ARON / TO: LENA<New>Mira is in Shelter Four. If
you can reach her, stay with
her. Don't come back here for
me.<New>UNSENT / LENA
Mira, it's Lena. Are you
there? Please answer.<New>TRANSMISSION LOST
No later entry recovered.<New><Emeralda>
"What happened to Mira...?"<New><Elly>
"I don't know..."<Close>

LAUNCH CONTROL DESK
ARCHIVED RECALL RECORD / 6083
DIRECTIVE 0320
Recall requested.<New>Executive response:
not authorized.
Strategic release confirmed.
Command link lost.
Reserve magazines sealed.<Close>
